--- Thanks @ferrolho for making this release possible! many bug fixes - The volume curve uses thirty equal 2 dB steps (-58 dB to 0 dB) saved independently for each output, and volume buttons step once when clicked with the screen off. Wheel clicks have a dedicated Click Volume setting (Low, Medium, High), equalizer and audio effects run only when custom values are active, and graphic equalizer adjustments apply immediately while editing. - Only one audio source plays at a time: starting a track pauses the FM radio, opening a video pauses playback, and starting USB Mass Storage stops the radio. The FM radio remains controllable with media buttons from any screen while active or paused. - Long-pressing the center button opens an in-place track menu for playlist actions and album browsing. A single center press toggles a full-width lyrics overlay with edge fades, and a new Lyrics Keep Screen On setting prevents the display from sleeping during playback while lyrics are visible. Holding Play/Pause stops playback and rewinds to the beginning, while holding Next or Previous seeks up to 120x speed. - The audio spectrum visualizer draws in the dominant album artwork color, stays visible at low volume levels, and stops its capture thread whenever the screen turns off or another screen is shown. Track times format in the classic style (`2:08`, `-0:34`, `1:02:08`), with a Total Time toggle to display total track length in place of remaining time. - Physical button presses now register on release instead of initial push down, preventing duplicate inputs and ensuring held actions trigger cleanly. Hardware and Bluetooth remote controls continue to handle playback when the screen is dark, the on-screen keyboard standardizes on the QWERTY layout, and wheel scrolling loops consistently across Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Music Quiz, and playlist screens. - Cellular modem services stay permanently disabled on the Y2 to conserve battery. Bluetooth pairing accepts numeric comparison requests without requiring a touch screen, a Discoverable toggle makes the player visible to cars and external devices for two minutes, and track metadata transmits over AVRCP to in-vehicle displays. Music automatically pauses on Bluetooth disconnect or headphone removal and resumes if reconnected within four hours. - Media scans compare file modification timestamps and sizes, re-reading only altered tracks and speeding up subsequent library rescans. Folder browsing defaults to secondary storage (`/storage/sdcard1/Music`), supports upward navigation (`..`), and lets you switch between storage volumes. Multi-genre tags are cataloged individually across FLAC, Opus, Ogg Vorbis, and ALAC files. - Music menus include new options for Compilations, Shuffle Songs, and Group Albums (by Title or Title and Artist). iPod-style smart playlists for Recently Played and Top 25 Most Played tracks replace the legacy album history tracker. - Cover Flow sorts albums by artist and then title, positions the artist name below the album cover, and jumps letter by letter during rapid wheel rotation. Fast wheel turns in song and album lists also jump alphabetically. - Classic themes use the iPod Classic split-screen layout with slow cover motion, menu drop shadows, and matching zoom transitions. A low-battery warning banner appears at 10% battery with a "Please charge" screen at 2%. In the Y2 ROM, Android's stock battery dialog and low-power audio alert are disabled. - A long press on the power button opens a dedicated iPod-style Power screen with Restart and Power Off options. Destructive actions like Reset Settings, Clear Album Art, Last.fm Log Out, and Settings Import now confirm on dedicated action screens where Back cancels. - Settings are arranged into iPod-style categories with options to export and import settings backups, show On/Off toggles as switches (`Toggle Style`), and fade the top and bottom edges of long lists (`List Edges`). Themes can be switched without restarting the launcher, including an Auto theme that tracks local sunrise and sunset. - Connecting storage switches the USB gadget mode to `mass_storage` before sharing partitions so partitions mount cleanly on host systems. The USB device name advertises Innioasis with the model number rather than generic MediaTek defaults, release builds stop on APIs newer than KitKat (API 19), and continuous integration checks verify 100% translation coverage across all seven languages. #### Release assets | File | Target device | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `InniClassic-20261104.apk` | All devices (Y1 / Y2) | Standalone launcher APK (sideload or install) | | `update.json` | All devices | OTA update metadata for in-app updater | | `rom_y2.zip` | Innioasis Y2 (MT6582) | Complete flashable ROM with dual-storage, watchdog & clickwheel keylayout | | `rom_y1_type_a.zip` (`rom.zip`) | Innioasis Y1 (Type A) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware 2.0.0 or higher | | `rom_y1_type_b.zip` (`rom_type_b.zip`) | Innioasis Y1 (Type B) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware below 2.0.0 | | `SHA256SUMS.txt` | All files | SHA-256 integrity checksums | Full changelog: https://github.com/JonaszPotoniec/inniclassic-y2/compare/20261017...20261104

--- The Biggest Release! - The entire application codebase has been rewritten from Java to 100% Kotlin, decomposing the monolithic main activity into dedicated domain managers, screen controllers, and an input router, backed by 16 regression test suites running in CI. - Audiobooks is now a dedicated top-level section on the main menu, with hierarchical Jellyfin sync (Author -> Book -> Chapter), cover art downloads, continuous bookmark persistence across reboots, full chapter playlist resume, and a unified split-screen layout. - The Videos section now provides a hierarchical browser for Movies, TV Series (with seasons and episodes), and raw directories, split-screen poster previews, Jellyfin video and thumbnail sync, and an automatic directory migration for existing files. - Music Quiz transitions to an endless survival mode with six questions per round, speed scaling down to five seconds, a between-round pause screen with a heart shop, a persistent top 10 leaderboard, and tiered year question distractors. - A new Recently Played Albums menu item beneath Cover Flow tracks up to 50 recently played albums with cover art, track counts, track-number-ordered browsing, and an option to clear playback history. - Device shutdown now saves the active queue and playback position, automatically restoring the player in a paused state at the exact track and timestamp after rebooting. - Playback cleanly pauses and rewinds to the first track when finishing an album with repeat turned off, while the library scanner now skips files smaller than 1KB and logs corrupt audio files. - Back navigation now preserves selected row focus and scroll position across the main menu, settings, playlists, and browser lists instead of resetting to the top item. - Split-screen pages in Music, Videos, and Audiobooks now share a unified 242dp status bar width matching the left navigation pane, while video browsing fixes eliminate poster clipping, top gaps, and double padding. - Now Playing album art now reliably updates on the main menu and music split panes during playback. - The theme catalog has been streamlined to Classic Light and Classic Dark, automatically cleaning up leftover assets from legacy themes during startup. - Physical buttons and wheel haptic feedback are now completely muted while the screen is off when Screen-Off Control is disabled, and the idle backlight sleep timer now stays synchronized with system settings. #### Release assets | File | Target device | Notes | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `InniClassic-20261017.apk` | All devices (Y1 / Y2) | Standalone launcher APK (sideload or install) | | `update.json` | All devices | OTA update metadata for in-app updater | | `rom_y2.zip` | Innioasis Y2 (MT6582) | Complete flashable ROM with dual-storage, watchdog & clickwheel keylayout | | `rom_y1_type_a.zip` (`rom.zip`) | Innioasis Y1 (Type A) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware 2.0.0 or higher | | `rom_y1_type_b.zip` (`rom_type_b.zip`) | Innioasis Y1 (Type B) | Flashable ROM for Y1 players with original firmware below 2.0.0 | | `SHA256SUMS.txt` | All files | SHA-256 integrity checksums | Full changelog: https://github.com/JonaszPotoniec/inniclassic-y2/compare/20261013...20261017

--- - Volume now uses a 30-step virtual scale with an iPod-style overlay across all screens instead of the stock Android popup. It works across music, video playback, FM radio, and Music Quiz, and includes six extra-quiet digital sub-steps at the bottom of the scale (down to -28 dBFS) for sensitive earphones. - A full QWERTY on-screen keyboard is now available in Settings alongside the original grid layout. It includes a symbol layer, column memory when moving vertically across the spacebar, lighter 10ms key vibration, and full punctuation (`; : , / \ ( ) [ ] { } < > ' ~ \`` and `|`) for Wi-Fi passwords and search queries. - Cover Flow and album lists use a 9-slot buffered layout and a 256x256 disk and RAM thumbnail cache (`.y1_thumbs_cache`), eliminating card pop-in and lag when spinning the wheel fast or reversing direction. - Holding the Center button for 0.8 seconds now locks all buttons and turns the screen off (Hold mode, from upstream 1.4.4). Hold Center again to unlock. - On Now Playing, wheel seeking previews the target time in 5-second steps until you press Center to jump, and pausing in the Classic theme keeps album art bright while remembering your active bottom bar mode. Starting a video also pauses active music so the Play/Pause button controls the video. - Custom themes no longer reset to the default theme after unplugging from USB Mass Storage because the selected theme is now saved by name instead of folder scan order.
